house.description: Targeting property tax refund expanded for taxes payable in 2026.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; property tax refunds; expanding the targeting property tax refund for taxes payable in 2026.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ONETIME EXPANSION OF TARGETING PROPERTY TAX REFUND FOR PROPERTY TAXES PAYABLE IN 2026. +]

[+Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, for refunds based on property taxes payable in 2026, the refund calculated under Minnesota Statutes, section 290A.04, subdivision 2h, must be calculated by substituting eight percent for 12 percent. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for refunds based on property taxes payable in 2026 only. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; property tax refunds; expanding the targeting property tax refund for taxes payable in 2026.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ONETIME EXPANSION OF TARGETING PROPERTY TAX REFUND FOR PROPERTY TAXES PAYABLE IN 2026.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, for refunds based on property taxes payable in 2026, the refund calculated under Minnesota Statutes, section 290A.04, subdivision 2h, must be calculated by substituting eight percent for 12 percent.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for refunds based on property taxes payable in 2026 only.
